pages.title: Nice to meet you
pages.instruction: Listen as Ana and Kim meet, then read together

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hi! I’m Kim. I’m from Korea
lines.audioText: Hi! I’m Kim. I’m from Korea.
lines.translation: Oi! Eu sou a Kim. Eu sou da Coreia

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Hi, Kim! I’m Ana. I’m from Brazil. Nice to meet you
lines.audioText: Hi, Kim! I’m Ana. I’m from Brazil. Nice to meet you.
lines.translation: Oi, Kim! Eu sou a Ana. Eu sou do Brasil. Prazer em te conhecer

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. How are you?
lines.audioText: Nice to meet you too. How are you?
lines.translation: O prazer é meu. Como você está?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m good, thanks. I’m hungry! And you?
lines.audioText: I’m good, thanks. I’m hungry! And you?
lines.translation: Estou bem, obrigada. Estou com fome! E você?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’m tired, but I’m happy. Welcome, Ana!
lines.audioText: I’m tired, but I’m happy. Welcome, Ana!
lines.translation: Estou cansada, mas estou feliz. Bem-vinda, Ana!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Thank you! It’s nice to be here
lines.audioText: Thank you! It’s nice to be here.

pages.title: Meet someone new
pages.instruction: Be the person on the card. Introduce yourself and ask two questions

pages.title: A new friend at the café
pages.instruction: Listen to Kim, then get ready to say hello
pages.message: Hi! It’s Kim. This is my friend Mia. Mia is from the United States. We’re at the café. Come and say hello! I’m happy you’re here. How are you today? Are you hungry
pages.audioText: Hi! It’s Kim. This is my friend Mia. Mia is from the United States. We’re at the café. Come and say hello! I’m happy you’re here. How are you today? Are you hungry?
